scope: Original t*M/(2*N) bound of Lemma5.2 under the existing positive-even interval and 2*M<=N hypotheses; legacy quarter-bound consequence.
mechanism: Exclude frequency zero from the interval Fourier energy: N*M-M^2. With K=floor(N^2/M^2), use N<=K*M and N^2<(K+1)*M^2 to obtain the strict tail estimate N^2/(2*K)<M^2/2+M^3/(2*N).
limits: This audit covers the new original numerical bound and its compatibility theorem.
Other original Weyl and intermediate bounds remain open.
